name: George Nostrant Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large single-family residence with a brown roof and multiple connected sections|A paved driveway leads to the house, with a black pickup truck parked near the front|The lot features mature pine trees surrounding the home, with open gravel and some landscaped areas around the foundation

alpha.desc: The front of the multi-storied residence shows the main facade with a covered entry area|The driveway approaches the house, and a black pickup truck is parked in front|Mature pine trees frame the property on multiple sides, with gravel and open areas around the home|Utility boxes are located right of the driveway entry point, along the road

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the large home with mature pine trees providing screening|The driveway and parking area are visible, along with open gravel and natural vegetation around the structure|A large deck spans most of the back of the residence

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the deck|Mature pine trees surround the rear of the home, with open gravel and some landscaped space|The layout provides open areas around the house.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation continuing the multi-section roofline|Mature pine trees frame the property, with the driveway and parking area visible|Open gravel and natural vegetation surround the home.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved and gravel driveway that leads directly to the front of the house and allows for turnaround. Mature pine trees surround much of the property and may limit some visibility and sightlines but do not appear to create major obstructions. The open gravel and landscaped areas around the home provide reasonable space for emergency vehicle staging.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle access available to the rear of the house? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible from the available imagery?
